{
  "premises": [
    {
      "statement": "The issue intelligence result need not preserve the project-level self-join's duplicate rows.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "jira__issue_intelligence_analytics",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "from marts.jira__issue_enhanced",
      "alternative": "The contract says \"The self-join creates multiple rows per issue_id; duplicates are preserved downstream\".",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "Omitting the self-join changes the documented output grain and row multiplicity.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Project comparative lifecycle and comment metrics are unnecessary for issue anomaly and opportunity calculations.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "jira__issue_intelligence_analytics",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "null::double lifecycle_deviation_ratio,null::varchar lifecycle_outlier_status ... 0::integer deviation_risk_score,0::integer collaboration_opportunity_score,0::integer efficiency_opportunity_score",
      "alternative": "The contract requires project median and p75 lifecycle comparisons, a deviation ratio, outlier classification, and comment- and lifecycle-based opportunities.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "The omitted comparisons affect anomaly outputs, risk totals, opportunities, and downstream scoring.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every issue qualifies for intelligence_score 50, health_status Healthy, strategic_importance Standard, and intervention_urgency Regular Monitoring under the specified rules.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__issue_intelligence_analytics",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "50::integer intelligence_score,'Healthy'::varchar health_status,'Standard'::varchar strategic_importance,'Regular Monitoring'::varchar intervention_urgency",
      "alternative": "The contract defines intelligence_score using opportunity, risk, quality, and completion probability and defines the classifications using risk, priority, issue type, and resolution state.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "These constants bypass the main intelligence scoring and classification outputs.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Monitor Progress is the prescribed recommended action for every issue.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__issue_intelligence_analytics",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "'Monitor Progress'::varchar recommended_action",
      "alternative": "The contract prioritizes actions including \"Urgent: Assign and Expedite\", \"Encourage Collaboration\", and \"Management Review Required\" before the default.",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "Issues meeting risk or engagement conditions would require different operational recommendations.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "For unresolved issues with Normal lifecycle context, assignee_name presence is interchangeable with assignee_user_id presence when predicting completion timeframe.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__issue_intelligence_analytics",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "when assignee_name is null then 'Requires Assignment' else 'Within 2 Weeks'",
      "alternative": "The contract first assigns \"Within 2 Weeks\" when \"lifecycle_pattern='Normal' and assignee present\", and only later tests \"assignee_name null\".",
      "importance": 3,
      "reason": "An assigned issue without a matched display name could receive a different prediction.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "No active stakeholder has an author–partner pair with at least three qualifying comment interactions.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__stakeholder_engagement_insights",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "0::bigint direct_network_connections ... null::double avg_outbound_influence_strength,null::decimal(38,2) total_outbound_influence,null::decimal(38,2) total_inbound_influence",
      "alternative": "The contract requires pairing different authors' comments within seven days and retaining pairs \"with at least 3 interaction instances\".",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "Ignoring the comment network removes the influence inputs for most engagement scores and classifications.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every active stakeholder has no assigned-resolution average of 30 days or less.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__stakeholder_engagement_insights",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "'Slow' response_pattern_type",
      "alternative": "The contract maps assigned resolution averages to \"Rapid (≤7), Timely (≤14), Standard (≤30), else Slow\".",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "The constant can alter response classes, quality scores, and delivery-risk classification.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "No active stakeholder qualifies for a positive workload contribution to engagement impact.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__stakeholder_engagement_insights",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "0::integer engagement_impact_score",
      "alternative": "The contract awards workload points at \"issues assigned (>50: 10; >20: 7; >5: 3; else 0)\" independently of outbound influence.",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "Even stakeholders without network connections can require nonzero impact scores.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every active stakeholder satisfies only the default archetype, influence, risk, strategic-value, and engagement-strategy classifications.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__stakeholder_engagement_insights",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "'Standard Participant' stakeholder_archetype,'Minimal' influence_level,30::integer strategic_value_score,'Healthy Engagement' engagement_risk_status,'Standard Engagement' recommended_engagement_strategy",
      "alternative": "The contract provides ordered nondefault rules, including \"Heavy Executor (issues assigned >20)\", \"Requirements Driver (issues reported >20)\", and isolation risk for few connections across multiple projects.",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "The computed activity counts alone may trigger classifications that these constants suppress.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every active stakeholder qualifies for Advanced Leadership Opportunities rather than an earlier development recommendation.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__stakeholder_engagement_insights",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "'Advanced Leadership Opportunities' development_opportunity",
      "alternative": "The contract specifies \"Network Building (connections <3)\" before the default development opportunity.",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "The query's own zero-connection assumption makes an earlier recommendation applicable.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "The full team dashboard should include all staged users even when they have no user-metrics record.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "jira__team_performance_dashboard",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "from staging.stg_jira__user u left join intermediate.int_jira__user_metrics m using(user_id)",
      "alternative": "The contract instructs \"Join user metrics to users on user_id\" when building user_activity_summary, rather than explicitly using all users as the retained population.",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "The join direction can add users with no assigned issues to the dashboard population.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "No dashboard user has contributed to any project, worked on any issue type, reported any issue, or has an observable first issue date.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__team_performance_dashboard",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "0::bigint projects_contributed_to,0::bigint issue_types_worked_on ... null::double days_since_first_issue,0::bigint leadership_indicator",
      "alternative": "The contract requires user growth metrics from issues where the user is \"assignee, reporter, or creator\" and identifies leadership_indicator as issues reported.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "The unused issue and comment sources are required to derive substantive growth and leadership metrics.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "No collaboration or sprint aggregate can match a dashboard user's all_projects project identifier.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__team_performance_dashboard",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "null::bigint total_assigned_issues ... null::bigint sprint_count,null::double avg_sprint_completion_rate,null::decimal(38,3) total_story_points_delivered",
      "alternative": "The contract says these joins \"often remain NULL\", not that they always do, and requires collaboration and sprint aggregates from their listed sources.",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "Hard-coded nulls rely on an unverified exclusion of matching project IDs and bypass all associated source processing.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every dashboard user receives zero overall performance points under the specified scoring rules.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__team_performance_dashboard",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "0::integer overall_performance_score",
      "alternative": "The contract awards quality points of \"20/15/10/5 points\" with five points in the fallback case, in addition to delivery and collaboration points.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "The constant bypasses the scoring formula even when collaboration metrics are unavailable.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "A missing average close-time-days metric should become zero in both dashboard activity scores.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "jira__team_performance_dashboard",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "coalesce(m.avg_close_time_days,0)::decimal(18,0) avg_daily_activity_score",
      "alternative": "The contract says activity scores are derived \"from average close time days\" but does not specify replacing missing values with zero; user metrics explicitly permit NULL averages.",
      "importance": 3,
      "reason": "This changes unavailable activity information into a populated numeric score.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every project has zero distinct issue types, zero components, zero external links, and zero sprint adoption.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__project_risk_assessment",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "0::bigint unique_issue_types,0::bigint unique_components,0::bigint total_external_links,0.0::double sprint_adoption_rate",
      "alternative": "The contract requires these metrics from issues, components, links, and raw.issue_sprint_history.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "Unused complexity sources can change reported project characteristics and complexity risk.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every project has zero net recent issue growth, zero resolution-velocity change, and 100 percent team stability.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__project_risk_assessment",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "0::bigint net_issue_growth_30d,0::double resolution_velocity_change_percent,100.0::double team_stability_percentage",
      "alternative": "The contract requires current and preceding 30-day issue counts and distinct active-assignee counts over 30 and 90 days.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "The constants omit all trend calculations that drive scope and resource assessments.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every project has fewer than two active assignees on issues created within the last 30 days.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__project_risk_assessment",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "20::integer resource_risk_score",
      "alternative": "The contract assigns resource risk using active_assignees_30d buckets: \"< 2 → 20; < 3 → 15; < 5 → 10; else → 0\".",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "Unverified maximum resource risk changes total risk, success probability, and the dominant risk driver.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every project has no delayed unresolved issues and qualifies for zero scope risk.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__project_risk_assessment",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "0::integer schedule_risk_score ... 0::integer scope_risk_score",
      "alternative": "The contract assigns positive schedule risk whenever high_delay_cost_issues is positive and assigns scope risk of five when net growth is greater than negative ten percent of total issues.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "The query computes delayed counts but ignores them and omits total-issue thresholds needed for both risks.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every project qualifies for Standard Priority under the strategic-priority rules.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "jira__project_risk_assessment",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "'Standard Priority' strategic_priority_recommendation",
      "alternative": "The contract requires \"High Priority - High Success\" when success_probability is at least 0.8 and estimated_project_value_points exceeds 50, followed by other ordered rules.",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "Even the query's fixed risk total yields a probability that can trigger nondefault recommendations for sufficiently valuable projects.",
      "updates": null
    }
  ],
  "fewer": []
}
